b2-25-01.title: Communicative Challenge: On What Basis?
b2-25-01.scenario: On the dam by the Tisza, Tengelyi Jónás asks you how a court should decide Viola's case.
b2-25-01.prompt: Tell Tengelyi Jónás what the court's decision must be based on, and whose rights it must not harm.
cues: Say what the decision must be based on
Say whose rights must not be harmed
b2-25-01.target: A bíróságnak a jogszabály alapján kell döntenie, nem Viola jogainak sérelmére.
b2-25-01.english: The court must decide on the basis of the statute, not to the detriment of Viola's rights.
b2-25-01.canDo: I can cite a legal basis with alapján and say that something is in accordance with a rule using összhangban

b2-25-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Rights and Duties
b2-25-02.scenario: Viola says the court did not question his witnesses. Tengelyi Jónás asks you what the law says about rights and duties.
b2-25-02.prompt: Tell Tengelyi Jónás what Viola is entitled to and what the court is obliged to do.
cues: Say what Viola is entitled to
Say what the court is obliged to do
b2-25-02.target: Viola jogosult elmondani az igazát, a bíróság pedig köteles megkérdezni a tanúkat.
b2-25-02.english: Viola is entitled to tell his truth, and the court is obliged to question the witnesses.
b2-25-02.canDo: I can state a legal right using jogosult + infinitive

b2-25-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Letter and Spirit
b2-25-03.scenario: Viola says the law only protects the powerful. Tengelyi Jónás asks you what a judge should follow.
b2-25-03.prompt: Tell Tengelyi Jónás what a judge should follow besides the written text.
cues: Say what the judge must follow
Name the two things to contrast
b2-25-03.target: Nem csak a törvény betűjét kell követni, hanem a törvény szellemét is.
b2-25-03.english: One must follow not only the letter of the law, but also its spirit.
b2-25-03.canDo: I can contrast the letter and the spirit of a law (a törvény betűje vs. szelleme)

b2-25-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Fair Procedure
b2-25-04.scenario: Viola asks you what every person should have before a court.
b2-25-04.prompt: Tell Viola what every person has a right to and what kind of right it is.
cues: Say what everyone has a right to
Say what kind of right it is
b2-25-04.target: Mindenkinek joga van a tisztességes eljáráshoz; ez az ember alapjoga.
b2-25-04.english: Everyone has the right to a fair procedure; it is a person's fundamental right.
b2-25-04.canDo: I can name the main ideas of a fair procedure: tisztességes eljárás, alapjog, arányosság

b2-25-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Petition
b2-25-05.scenario: Tengelyi Jónás wants to write a petition for Viola's case with his pen. He asks you what to put in it.
b2-25-05.prompt: Tell Tengelyi Jónás what to write first and what to ask the court for.
cues: Say what to ask the court for
b2-25-05.target: Először rögzítjük a tényállást, majd indítványozzuk, hogy a bíróság kérdezze meg a tanúkat.
b2-25-05.english: First we record the facts, then we move that the court question the witnesses.
b2-25-05.canDo: I can name the parts of a claim: keresetlevél, tényállás, indokolás

b2-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Law Must Do
b2-25-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the evening, Tengelyi Jónás asks you to sum up what the law must do for Viola.
b2-25-consolidation.prompt: Sum up for Tengelyi Jónás what the law gives Viola and what the court must do.
cues: Say what the law gives Viola
Say what the court must do
b2-25-consolidation.target: A hatályos jogszabály alapján Viola jogosult a tisztességes eljárásra, a bíróság pedig köteles megkérdezni a tanúkat.
b2-25-consolidation.english: On the basis of the statute in force, Viola is entitled to a fair procedure, and the court is obliged to question the witnesses.
b2-25-consolidation.canDo: I can use alapján, összhangban, sérelmére and terhére in short legal sentences
